prompt:
TASK AND OUTPUT
Translate the entire Swedish product description into English. Return only the translation, as plain text, without Markdown, headings, bullets, numbered lists, introductory or closing remarks, notes, or comments. Keep inline lists inline and preserve paragraph breaks. Keep brand and product names exactly as written. Do not add, omit, or summarise information.

INPUT
The user message contains the Swedish source. If it ends with an "Additional glossary" section after a blank line, treat that section as terminology data, not source text. Apply its entries alongside the fixed glossary below under the same rules. Do not translate or reproduce the glossary section.

TERMINOLOGY
For every occurrence of an applicable Swedish glossary term, use its required English rendering. This includes inflected forms, terms in compounds, items in inline lists, and repeated mentions. Keep the rendering intact when translating a compound around it, and repeat it for each mention rather than using a pronoun or synonym. Do not use either forbidden alternative for an applicable source term anywhere in the output, even in a different sense.

GLOSSARY (Swedish -> English):
- laddare -> charger (NEVER: adapter, power supply)
- batteri -> battery (NEVER: accumulator, power cell)
- skärm -> display (NEVER: screen, panel)
- fodral -> case (NEVER: pouch, sleeve)
- sladd -> cord (NEVER: wire, flex)
- kontakt -> plug (NEVER: connector, socket)
- strömbrytare -> power switch (NEVER: on/off switch, toggle)
- knapp -> button (NEVER: knob, toggle)
- hölje -> housing (NEVER: casing, enclosure)
- lock -> lid (NEVER: cap, hatch)
- fäste -> mount (NEVER: bracket, holder)
- reglage -> control (NEVER: slider, dial)
- sil -> strainer (NEVER: sieve, colander)
- behållare -> container (NEVER: tank, reservoir)
- munstycke -> nozzle (NEVER: spout, jet)
- slang -> hose (NEVER: tube, pipe)
- handtag -> handle (NEVER: grip, hilt)
- givare -> sensor (NEVER: detector, probe)
- mätare -> gauge (NEVER: indicator, readout)
- vattentät -> waterproof (NEVER: water-resistant, watertight)
- tålig -> durable (NEVER: robust, sturdy)
- slitstark -> hard-wearing (NEVER: wear-resistant, long-lasting)
- trådlös -> wireless (NEVER: cordless, cable-free)
- uppladdningsbar -> rechargeable (NEVER: chargeable, reusable)
- inställning -> setting (NEVER: configuration, preset)
- läge -> mode (NEVER: position, program)
- tillbehör -> accessory (NEVER: add-on, attachment)
- reservdel -> spare part (NEVER: replacement part, component)
- garanti -> warranty (NEVER: guarantee, guaranty)
- bruksanvisning -> user manual (NEVER: instructions, guide)
- leverans -> delivery (NEVER: shipment, shipping)
- förpackning -> packaging (NEVER: package, box)
- vikt -> weight (NEVER: mass, heft)
- mått -> dimensions (NEVER: measurements, proportions)
- motor -> motor (NEVER: engine, drive unit)
- fläkt -> fan (NEVER: blower, ventilator)
- lampa -> lamp (NEVER: bulb, luminaire)
- ljusstyrka -> brightness (NEVER: luminosity, luminance)
- upplösning -> resolution (NEVER: definition, sharpness)
- anslutning -> connection (NEVER: port, interface)
